nodes.description: Immutable public address of the logic (implementation) contract; used as the delegatecall target for all proxy calls.
Constructor(address _logic, bytes _initializationCalldata) stores the logic address and delegatecalls the initialization calldata, reverting with returned data if the call fails.
Payable fallback() that copies calldata and performs a raw delegatecall into the immutable logic address, bubbling up revert/return data.
Raw delegatecall inside the constructor executing attacker-supplied _initializationCalldata in the proxy's storage context.
Raw assembly delegatecall in the fallback forwarding arbitrary msg calldata to the logic contract, executing external code in the proxy's storage context.
Constructor parameter holding the address of the logic contract to be stored and later delegatecalled.
Constructor parameter containing the initialization calldata executed via delegatecall.
Local bool capturing the success flag returned by the constructor's delegatecall.
Local bytes holding the revert/return data of the constructor's delegatecall, used in the require message.
Local variable in fallback() that caches the logic address used as the delegatecall target.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _logic is written into the immutable state variable logic.
The _initializationCalldata parameter is passed directly as the calldata of the constructor's delegatecall.
The constructor executes the delegatecall to the logic contract during deployment.
The success flag of the constructor delegatecall is assigned to the local variable _ok.
The return/revert data of the constructor delegatecall is assigned to the local variable returnData.
The state variable logic is read into the local variable _impl inside the fallback.
The local _impl address is used as the target of the fallback's delegatecall.
The fallback function body executes the delegatecall into the logic contract.
The delegatecall executes arbitrary code of the logic contract in the proxy context, which can call back into the proxy fallback before the current call completes.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _logic is only consumed by the constructor and is merged into that core function node.
Parameter _initializationCalldata feeds directly into the constructor's delegatecall unsafe operation.
Local _ok only records the result of the constructor delegatecall unsafe operation.
Local returnData only holds the return data of the constructor delegatecall unsafe operation.
Local _impl only supplies the target address for the fallback delegatecall unsafe operation.
